Intimation of Schedule of Conference Call for Q2FY27 | Vedant Fashions Limited (“the 
Company”) 
Ref: 
Information under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended (“Listing 
Regulations”) of the Conference Call 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the Listing Regulations, we would like to inform you that the Conference Call to 
discuss the Company’s business strategy and outlook post the declaration of its Q2FY27, has been scheduled on 
Friday, November 06, 2026 at 3.30 P.M. IST, subject to the approval and announcement of financial results of 
the Company for the quarter and half-year ended on September 30, 2026. 
 
The details of the aforesaid conference call and registration link are enclosed herewith. The same will also be 
made available on the website of the Company at www.vedantfashions.com. 
 
We request you to kindly take the aforesaid information on record and disseminate the same on your respective 
websites. 
 
Thank you. 
 
 
For, Vedant Fashions Limited

Navin Pareek  
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
